title: Kyle Baker
description: Han and Chewie try to rescue Lando from the jaws of that insatible sand monster, the Sarlacc, in this scene inspired by RETURN OF THE JEDI. "STAR WARS was one of my favorite movies as a child," recalls Baker, "so it was a joy working on this project." Baker started drawing comics for Marvel and DC back in 1984, and has also written two graphic novels, WHY I HATE SATURN and THE COWBOY WALLY SHOW. His work has appeared in SPY, THE WILLAGE VOICE, ESQUIRE, NATIONAL LAMPOON and other publications too numerous and low-paying to mention.
